text.en:
The Cervantes National School of Arts and Trades created under Republic Act Numbered
Forty-four hundred and twenty four located in the Municipality of Cervantes, Province of Ilocos Sur, Region
I, is hereby converted into an agro-industrial school to be known as Cervantes Agro-Industrial School.

In addition to its present four-year secondary trade curriculum and the revised secondary
education curriculum, the Cervantes Agro-Industrial School shall also provide a four year secondary industrial
and agricultural education, and shall develop skills in the field of agriculture and industry, home technology
and food trades, practical arts and furniture design and construction, and vocational electives. These shall be
done through scientific research and extension that will provide skills necessary and adequate for agricultural
and industrial work/employment.
Other related courses may be offered as the demand arises, and as the Ministry of Education and Culture may
deem wise and necessary.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 and Batas Pambansa Blg. 131 for the Ministry of
Education and Culture intended for new national schools: Provided, That the local government unit concerned
shall continue to provide its share in the cost of operating and maintaining said school. Starting Calendar Year
1983 such sum as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the school shall be provided in the
annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
